name: kentos-cad
description: Türkiye odaklı CBS + CAD harita yazılımı
$comment: Manifest mode against a real pinned baseline (CLAUDE.md 5.12).
This file covers the libraries with native dependencies. Small pure-C++
libraries are pinned by commit SHA in cmake/KentOSCadDependencies.cmake instead,
so a fresh checkout builds on all three platforms with nothing installed.
Before enabling any of these: read its LICENSE, confirm GPLv3 compatibility,
record it in NOTICE and regenerate the CycloneDX SBOM in the same PR.

gdal.$comment: default-features off on purpose: the network drivers are what io.md P14 refuses, and every driver is parser attack surface /tests/fuzz does not cover. The runtime allow-list is cmake/KentOSCadGdalDrivers.cmake.
gdal.description: Vector format I/O (DXF, GeoPackage) — KENTOS_WITH_GDAL. Linked; licence recorded in /NOTICE.

proj.description: Coordinate transformation, TUREF/TM3 and geoid grids — KENTOS_WITH_PROJ

cgal.description: Exact arithmetic, straight skeleton for setbacks — KENTOS_WITH_CGAL
